In this guideStory checklist

Camp Journal

The Camp Journal opens after stage 2-40. Open it from camp to see your story progress, and tap the event bubble when it appears.

Story checklist

There are 17 stories with three parts each. Finish all three parts of a story to earn 100 Pinballs, for up to 1,700 Pinballs across the Journal.
